Biography

MD. Shinha Sarder is the Founder & CEO of IT Tech BD and Biostar TV World. Born on November 5, 2004, he is recognized as an Engineer, Developer, Entrepreneur, Musical Artist, Author, Researcher, and Content Creator. He is a Computer Science and Engineering (CSE) student at the Northern University of Business and Technology, Khulna, and an alumnus of Khulna Zilla School. His father, MD. Lutfor Rahaman, is a lawyer, and his mother, Samima Sultana, is a private sector professional.
